observations: A red/orange metal gas cylinder lies on its side inside what looks like a car trunk.
Cylinder has two carry handles and a valve/regulator fitting visible at the top.
Surface shows rust spots, scratches and faded paint consistent with heavy prior use.
No capacity stamp, serial number, manufacturer mark or test-date stamp is legible in the photo.
Other unrelated items (cleaning brush, bags, boxes) are in the background, confirming an informal/home setting rather than a shop.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOBODO PETER' overlays the image; this is a listing watermark, not a safety or capacity certification.

claims.evidence: No capacity stamp or marking is visible on the cylinder neck or body in photo 0; size is only inferred from general shape.
No import documentation, country-of-origin stamp, or paperwork shown; this is a seller-only claim about provenance.

risks.risk: True water capacity (e.g. whether it is actually 20kg vs a smaller common size like 12.5kg) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity/tare weight on the cylinder collar or neck.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the smallest plausible standard cylinder size until the stamp is shown.

risks.risk: No evidence of a current hydrostatic/leak test or valid safety certification; rust suggests possible age-related wall thinning.
risks.proof: Close-up of the stamped test date and any certification mark on the neck ring.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested/non-certified, i.e. requiring re-certification before refill.

risks.risk: Valve/regulator fitting condition (seal integrity, thread wear) cannot be judged from a static photo.
risks.proof: Short video showing the valve being opened/closed and a regulator seated with a hiss/leak check (e.g. soapy water test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a faulty/leaking valve needing replacement.

risks.risk: Extent of surface corrosion may be cosmetic or may indicate deeper pitting that affects structural safety.
risks.proof: Multiple clear, well-lit photos of the full body from several angles without background clutter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily corroded, worst-case structural condition.

risks.risk: Cylinder could be empty, partially filled, or have residual gas affecting handling/value.
risks.proof: Photo of a weighing scale with the cylinder on it, or a statement of current fill level backed by a receipt from a filling station.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the capacity/tare weight stamp on the cylinder neck or collar.
Close-up of any test date/certification stamp.
Video of the valve opening/closing and a leak check with soapy water or a connected regulator.
Full-body photos in better lighting without background clutter, from at least 3 angles.
Photo of the cylinder on a scale showing current weight.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used LPG gas cylinder, but none of the seller's claims (capacity, tokunbo origin, implied working condition) can be confirmed from the single cluttered photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
